test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What responsibility did the Supreme Court give to the National Environmental Engineering Research Institute (NEERI) in April 2025?

options.text: To study the impact of glass industries on the Taj Mahal
To relocate glass factories near the Taj Mahal
To promote tourism near the Taj Mahal

solution:
The correct answer is __**To study the impact of glass industries on the Taj Mahal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **April 2025**, the **Supreme Court of India** issued a directive to the **National Environmental Engineering Research Institute (NEERI)** to conduct a detailed scientific assessment.
 
• The primary responsibility assigned to **NEERI** was to **study the impact of glass industries** on the structural integrity and aesthetic preservation of the **Taj Mahal**.
 
• This study focuses on the environmental footprint of industrial units located within the **Taj Trapezium Zone (TTZ)**, specifically those involved in glass manufacturing in nearby regions like **Firozabad**. ***Hence, the statement regarding the impact of glass industries is correct.***
 
• The **Supreme Court** aims to determine if the emissions from these industries are contributing to the yellowing of the marble or "**marble cancer**," caused by chemical reactions with pollutants.
 
• **NEERI** is expected to provide data-driven recommendations on whether existing pollution control equipment in these factories is sufficient or if stricter regulations are required to protect the **UNESCO World Heritage Site**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Environmental Engineering Research Institute (NEERI):**
 
 
• It was established in **1958** and is headquartered in **Nagpur**, **Maharashtra**.
 
• It functions under the **Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)** and focuses on environmental monitoring, hazardous waste management, and environmental impact assessments.
 
• **NEERI** has been frequently consulted by the **Indian Judiciary** for expert technical opinions on environmental conservation cases.
 
 
 
• **The Taj Trapezium Zone (TTZ):**
 
 
• The **TTZ** is a defined area of approximately **10,400 square kilometers** around the **Taj Mahal**.
 
• It encompasses several districts including **Agra**, **Firozabad**, **Mathura**, **Hathras**, and **Etah** in **Uttar Pradesh**, as well as **Bharatpur** in **Rajasthan**.
 
• The zone was established following the **1996 Supreme Court** judgment to protect the monument from pollution-induced damage.
 
 
 
• **Glass Industry in Firozabad:**
 
 
• **Firozabad** is known as the "**Glass City of India**" due to its extensive cluster of glass-making units and bangle factories.
 
• Historically, these industries used **coal** and **coke**, which emitted high levels of **Sulfur Dioxide (SO2)** and **particulate matter**, posing a direct threat to the white marble of the **Taj Mahal**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Legal Precedents:** The protection of the **Taj Mahal** is governed by the landmark case of **M.C. Mehta vs. Union of India**, filed in the **1980s**, which led to the closure of several polluting industries.
 
• **Transition to Cleaner Fuel:** The **Supreme Court** previously mandated that industries in the **TTZ** must switch from traditional fuels to **Piped Natural Gas (PNG)** to minimize the carbon footprint and acidic emissions.
 
• **Marble Cancer:** This term refers to the corrosion of marble by **acid rain** (formed by **Sulfur Dioxide** and **Nitrogen Oxides** reacting with water vapor), which converts calcium carbonate into calcium sulfate, causing the surface to flake and turn yellow.
 
• **Current Status:** The **April 2025** order signifies the court's ongoing vigilance in balancing industrial economic activity with the preservation of **India's** cultural heritage through rigorous scientific auditing by **CSIR-NEERI**.
